## DECISION LOG (Architect-Approved)

**Decision 1 — CFED DEP-ID Resolution:**
The PRD registers the CFED Dataset as DEP-VIS-013, and the ConsciousPose Library as DEP-VIS-009. FR-VIS-14 incorrectly claimed DEP-VIS-009 for the CFED Dataset. This is resolved by updating FR-VIS-14 to align with the PRD (DEP-VIS-013).

**Decision 2 — Expression Schema Standardization:**
FR-VIS-14 defines the canonical JSON sub-schema for expression parameters (`expression_spec`). FR-VIS-16 produced an independent flat schema. To ensure Paradoxe (FR-VIS-03) can parse the output, FR-VIS-16 will adopt the exact `expression_spec` structure defined in FR-VIS-14.
